ACOUSTID_NOT_CONFIGURED: API key not set, add it under Settings, Integrations (optional)
BEETS_CLI_MISSING: beet command not found or not accessible
LIDARR_NOT_CONFIGURED: URL and API key not set, add them under Settings, Integrations (optional)
PLEX_NOT_CONFIGURED: Plex not connected, configure under Settings, Integrations (optional)
SLSKD_NOT_CONFIGURED: URL and API key not set, add them under Settings, Integrations (optional)
SLSKD_NETWORK_DISCONNECTED: API OK but not connected to Synthseek network
STORAGE_SAME_FILESYSTEM: Downloads ({{downloadsPath}}) and library ({{libraryPath}}) share a filesystem, imports move files atomically
STORAGE_CROSS_FILESYSTEM: Downloads ({{downloadsPath}}) and library ({{libraryPath}}) are on different filesystems, imports copy then delete and temporarily need space for both copies
USENET_NOT_CONFIGURED: Usenet indexer and SABnzbd are not configured (optional)
ARCHIVE_PAUSED: Paused for another {{seconds}}s after failures or a request to slow down
SOUNDCLOUD_UNAVAILABLE: The yt-dlp program SoundCloud downloads through did not answer
SUBSONIC_SOURCE_DISABLED: The Subsonic source is turned off (optional)
SUBSONIC_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No Subsonic server address and credentials (optional)
SUBSONIC_SOURCE_SELF: The address points at this Synthseek itself
TORRENT_SOURCE_DISABLED: The torrent source is turned off (optional)
TORRENT_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No Torznab indexer and qBittorrent address (optional)
TORRENT_SOURCE_INDEXER_FAILED: The Torznab indexer did not answer
TORRENT_SOURCE_CLIENT_FAILED: qBittorrent did not answer or refused the login
